purpose: Reference learning and secondary reconciliation; never an authoritative replacement for primary inventory.

projects.name: Starlink Mission Control
learn: Fleet history linked to spatial context
Explicit separation of observations, inferred state and simulation
caveats: GP catalogue coverage is not a complete physical inventory
Operational altitude is an inferred state, not confirmed commercial service
Simulated ISL routing and demo dish telemetry are not measured network performance

projects.name: Orbital Radar
learn: Constellation summaries linked to selected spatial views
caveats: No scraper, bulk harvest or private API without written permission
Public page retrieval only within permitted attributed user-query use; otherwise mark permission-required
Tracked payloads and page update dates do not establish complete inventory or exact observation epochs
Plans, active service and tracked payloads must not be conflated
